title: TypeSomething footer
description: A stone-grey footer: a big two-tone wordmark that types itself out, a tiny letter-spaced tagline, contact lines and round outline social buttons, three link columns with small bold uppercase headings, and a hairline bottom bar with copyright, underlined legal links, a badge and a round back-to-top button. Links underline in acid on hover; round buttons fill with ink.
notes: typing wordmark needs JavaScript (typing={false} turns it off); the static HTML shows the full name
